instructions.polygon: Click on the map to mark each vertex, or type its latitude and longitude and press "Add point". Finish with "Close polygon" or by clicking the first vertex.
instructions.polygonClosed: Drag a vertex to move it, or an edge's midpoint to add one. To delete a vertex, right-click it, or select it and use "Delete vertex".
instructions.point: Click on the map to place the farm, or type its latitude and longitude and press "Add point". The circle has the area you enter, and you can drag it.

howTo.title: How to draw the farm
howTo.alt: Animation: clicks on the satellite map mark each of the farm's vertices, then "Close polygon" closes it, and a vertex is dragged to adjust the edge.

steps.1: Type the farm's latitude and longitude and press “Go”, or move the map to it.
steps.2: Click on the map to place each vertex of the farm's boundary. If you know their coordinates, type them and press “Add point”.
steps.3: Press “Close polygon”, or click on the first vertex.
steps.4: To adjust the boundary, drag a vertex; to delete it, right-click it.

goTo.invalid: Use a latitude between -90 and 90 and a longitude between -180 and 180.

coordinates.selectHint: Click a row to select that vertex.

drawingErrors.crossing: That vertex would make the polygon's edges cross.
drawingErrors.minVertices: The polygon needs at least 3 vertices.
drawingErrors.cannotClose: Closing it would make the polygon's edges cross. Move or delete a vertex.

notEditable.format: This farm has no GeoJSON coordinates: draw it again to change its geometry.
notEditable.shape: This farm has holes or several parts, which can't be drawn here: draw it again to change its geometry.
notEditable.invalid: This farm's geometry couldn't be read: draw it again.

missingGeometry: Draw the polygon or place the point to add the farm.

fieldErrors.url: Enter a link starting with http:// or https://
